notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key.
Data release version indicator; stored as observation with custom concept for survey metadata.
Interview/examination participation status; maps to observation with custom concept (e.g., 1=Interviewed only, 2=Both).
Six-month exam period; maps to observation with custom concept (1=Nov-Apr, 2=May-Oct).
Gender: 1=Male (8507), 2=Female (8532). Use standard OMOP gender concepts.
Age in years at screening; derive year_of_birth from survey year minus age. Topcoded at 85.
Age in months at screening; stored as observation for precision, supplementing year_of_birth.
Age in months at exam; stored as observation for precise age at measurement events.
Race/ethnicity recode; maps to race_concept_id (e.g., 1=Mexican American, 3=Non-Hispanic White, 4=Non-Hispanic Black). Ethnicity handled separately.
Alternative linked race/ethnicity recode; stored as observation for supplementary race/ethnicity classification.
Veteran/military status; maps to observation with custom concept (1=Yes, 2=No).
Country of birth; can inform ethnicity or location concepts. Stored as observation with location concept.
Citizenship status; maps to observation with custom concept (1=Citizen, 2=Not citizen).
Length of time in US; ordinal categories mapped to observation with custom concept.
Education level for children/youth 6-19; maps to observation with custom concept.
Education level for adults 20+; maps to observation with custom concept.
Education recode (old version); maps to observation with custom concept.
Current school attendance; maps to observation with custom concept.
Marital status; maps to observation with custom concept (1=Married, 2=Widowed, etc.).
Total number in household; stored as observation with numeric value.
Annual household income range; maps to observation with custom concept.
Annual family income range; maps to observation with custom concept.
Poverty income ratio; continuous numeric value stored in observation.
Pregnancy status at exam; maps to observation with custom concept (1=Positive, 2=Not pregnant, 3=Cannot ascertain).
Household reference person gender; not mapped to participant's person record. Could be stored in observation if needed.
Household reference person age; not directly mapped to participant. Could be observation.
Household reference person country of birth; not participant data.
Household reference person education; not participant data.
Household reference person marital status; not participant data.
Spouse of household reference person education; not participant data.
Language of SP interview; maps to observation with custom concept (1=English, 2=Spanish).
Proxy used in SP interview; maps to observation (1=Yes, 2=No).
Interpreter used in SP interview; maps to observation (1=Yes, 2=No).
Language of family interview; maps to observation.
Proxy used in family interview; maps to observation.
Interpreter used in family interview; maps to observation.
Language of MEC interview; maps to observation.
Proxy used in MEC interview; maps to observation.
Interpreter used in MEC interview; maps to observation.
Language of ACASI interview; maps to observation.
Full sample 2-year interview weight; stored as observation with weight concept.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight; stored as observation with weight concept.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU; design variable stored as observation for survey analysis.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum; design variable stored as observation for survey analysis.
